title: Components · Showcase
heading: Components
lead: UI wrappers from shared/ui. Features only use these building blocks.

button.description: appUiButton on button or a, with variants, sizes and a loading state.

icon.description: app-ui-icon with the names from ui-icons.ts.

card.description: appUiCard with header, content and footer.
card.title: Shopping

alert.description: app-ui-alert for notices within the content.

attachment.description: app-ui-attachment shows a file or an image as a tile, several go into an appUiAttachmentGroup.
attachment.open: Open sample image {{ number }} in full size

empty.heading: No notes yet
empty.text: Create your first note to get started.

loading.heading: Spinner and skeleton
loading.description: Loading indicators. Usually app-async-content renders them.
loading.label: Loading example

navMenu.description: app-ui-nav-menu builds the navigation from an array. An item with children becomes a dropdown in the horizontal bar and a collapsible section in the vertical list.

breadcrumb.description: app-ui-breadcrumb shows where the page sits: links from the top down, the last item is the current page. Used in the admin area.

sheet.description: app-ui-sheet slides a panel in from the edge, e.g. for the mobile navigation.
sheet.heading: Filter
sheet.content: The content of the sheet is projected into it.

overlays.heading: Dialog, confirm dialog and toast
overlays.description: Opened through UiDialogService, UiConfirmDialogService and UiToastService.

dialog.heading: Change name
dialog.description: The name is returned as the result.
dialog.name: Name

richText.description: app-ui-rich-text shows stored rich text from app-form-rich-text. The HTML is reduced to the allowed formats before it is rendered.
richText.sample:
Groceries

Still missing for the weekend:

  • Milk

  • Bread

Never shop hungry.

Recipes are on example.org.
richText.pageDescription: With profile="page" for pages of this site, e.g. legal pages: links may also point to a path of the site or a phone number and open in the same tab, a path through the router.
richText.pageSample:
Contact

Jane Doe
1 Example Street
12345 Example City

Email: jane@example.org, phone: +49 1234

More in the privacy policy.

i18n.heading: Language and date
i18n.description: app-language-toggle switches the language, the localDate pipe formats in the locale of the language.
